whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Flavor Town,

I noticed your multi-cuisine restaurant has stellar 4.8★ reviews with over 600 happy diners on Gola Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, multi-cuisine menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/flavortown

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Flavor Town, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first multi-cuisine menu showcase and direct WhatsApp table reservation for Gola Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, photos aur reservation setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
